info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Knowledge Asset Management Manual-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of knowledge asset management manuals within the banking sector. It facilitates the submission of essential documentation that outlines practices, guidelines, and procedures for managing knowledge assets effectively. Typical consumers include banking professionals and operational teams who require a structured format for documenting and maintaining corporate knowledge. The operation supports businesses in enhancing their internal processes and leveraging knowledge assets for improved decision-making and regulatory compliance.

post.summary: Create a new management manual for knowledge assets.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new management manual that serves as a comprehensive guide for handling knowledge assets. You can include various sections detailing procedures, standards, and policies crucial for effective management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new management manual for knowledge assets. It should contain all relevant details necessary for the manual, as defined by the schema.
